children.text: Losing a loved one in an unexpected accident, such as a fatal car crash or workplace disaster, is something that no family should ever have to endure. If you believe the circumstances surrounding the death of your loved one should have been prevented, pursuing a wrongful death lawsuit in Colorado can bring a greater sense of justice, closure and peace to your family. The best way to strengthen your case during this trying time is by hiring a
wrongful death attorney in Denver
. Hiring a lawyer can come with many important benefits.
Someone Who Understands the Legal Process
Colorado’s wrongful death laws are confusing and constantly evolving. It is difficult for anyone who does not have legal training to understand all of the
statutes and regulations that apply to the average wrongful death case
. Unfortunately, even
one misstep by a plaintiff

can compromise the ability to obtain financial compensation. A wrongful death attorney will have years of training, education, and experience in this practice area to help you navigate the law. Your lawyer will know exactly how to handle the legal process in a way that optimizes your odds of success.
Cost and Time Savings

When you think about hiring an attorney, you may hesitate about the cost. In reality, however, hiring an attorney can save you money. A wrongful death case can be costly and time-consuming, especially when plaintiffs attempt to represent themselves. Without the assistance of an attorney, it can take far more time and money to process a claim. A
Denver injury lawyer
will know how to handle your case in the most efficient manner possible.

Without an attorney, you run the risk of making a major mistake that takes away your ability to recover compensation entirely, such as missing the strict deadline to file (two years in Colorado). This can cost you significantly more than the fee to hire an attorney, especially if the law firm operates on a contingency fee basis. With this payment arrangement, you will only pay a wrongful death lawyer out of the settlement or judgment obtained – never out of pocket.
Better Case Results

A wrongful death attorney will know the true value of your case and how to fight for fair results. Unlike an insurance company, which is a for-profit business that wants to capitalize on your claim, an attorney is an advocate who is sworn to protect your best interests. As an added protection, your attorney won’t get paid unless you do. This ensures an advocate on your side who will aggressively fight for maximum financial compensation. Statistically, claimants who hire attorneys recover greater compensation for their claims than self-represented plaintiffs, even after attorney’s fees are accounted for.
The Ability to Go to Trial

Most wrongful death cases in Colorado achieve settlements. A wrongful death trial can be expensive for everyone involved, but especially for an insurance company. Hiring an attorney shows an insurer that you can go to court to demand fair financial compensation, if necessary. This often results in higher settlement amounts offered to resolve cases pretrial. If the insurance company still refuses to offer fair compensation, having an attorney representing you during a wrongful death trial can be invaluable.
Support During This Difficult Time

Perhaps most important for grieving families is the personal support and care they receive from a wrongful death attorney. Your lawyer will be a great source of information, advice, and guidance for you and your family during this traumatic time. From relieving the burden of legal action from your shoulders to making sure that your family has everything it needs, your wrongful death lawyer will make it a little easier to mourn and begin the process of healing. You can focus on what matters most – your family – while your lawyer takes care of the rest.
